comparison.objective: Select and install the matching driver bit, then power-tighten a loose drawer knob screw.
comparison.physical_skill: Bit identification and insertion, powered screw engagement under axial alignment, drawer stabilization, and tool return.
comparison.success_condition: Correct bit installed; at least 1.3 mm powered feed; knob gap at most 0.2 mm; pass a 5 N hold test; stopped tool released stably for full score.
comparison.reason: The common bit insertion and screw turning are generic primitives. This record tests interchangeable-bit selection and powered threaded fastening; the candidate uses a fine hex bit to unlock and relock a moving collar setting and validates that setting through dynamic impacts.
